text.en:
NDRRMC Composition. The DICT and the DOT are hereby
included as members of the NDRRMC.
THE PRESIDENT OF THE PHILIPPINES

Funding Requirements. Funding requirements for the
implementation of this Order shall be included in the respective budgets of the DICT
and the DOTr.

Repeal. All orders, rules and regulations, issuances or any part
thereof inconsistent with the provisions of this Executive Order are hereby repealed,
amended or modified accordingly.

Separability. If any section or part of this Order is held
unconstitutional or invalid, the other sections or provisions not otherwise affected
shall remain in full force and effect.

Effectivity. This Executive Order shall take effect immediately.
DONE, in the City of Manila this 12t lay of
Our Lord, Two Thousand and Seventeen.
, in the year of
By the President:
SALVADOR C. MEDIALDEA
Executive Secretary 3
